Yep, I think text chat is needed.
One of the #1 requests I get in my worlds is adding pens or a keyboard. Mute players already have ways to communicate, but they're subpar. World creators shouldn't be the ones to provide this accessibility feature.
text chat is needed i physically can not speak and sometimes it gets so hard to communicate

I as a deaf gamer do have really difficult times communicating with people when it’s not in an asl world. I find people talk to me in worlds like Murder 4 where there’s no pens and makes it difficult to communicate. I have it standing in my bio that I’m deaf but I find many people getting annoyed by me as they think I’m ignoring them so they begin punching and just shooting me whenever. It makes it difficult just having fun playing the game when people just go to kill me cause they think I’m just rude. At this point being able to chat would really be a big help.
I think it would be a cool idea. They could base it on that text chat prefab a lot of people use but have it built into the menu.

@{62dee557df9d6f563542d6bd|full_name}: While I really wish it was a feature native to VRChat, we also have to remember that the people who make these OSC setups do it in their spare time, many of which may also be struggling financially...
Just because the tools are made for (or can be used by) people with disabilities, doesn't mean the people making the tools shouldn't be rewarded for their work.
